missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Забор' is in the nominative as the subject of 'стоит'. 'Высокий' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'вокруг дома' shows what it surrounds.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Забор' is the accusative direct object of 'красит'. As an inanimate masculine noun its accusative matches the nominative. 'Свой' marks possession.
Strategic focus: Genitive after с. 'Забора' is the genitive form required by 'с', expressing motion off the fence. 'Кот' is the nominative subject of 'спрыгнул'.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На заборе' uses the prepositional form 'заборе' after 'на' to show where the children sit. A static-location pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative after к. 'Забору' is the dative form governed by 'к', expressing movement toward the fence. 'Подошли' marks the arrival on foot.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after за. 'Забором' is the instrumental form required by 'за' to mean behind the fence. 'Цветы' is the nominative subject of 'растут'.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after много. 'Заборов' is the genitive plural required by the quantifier 'много'. 'Старых' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Заборы' is the nominative plural as the subject. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'давно сломаны' is the predicate. A clean plural model.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Забор' is the inanimate accusative direct object of 'построили', identical to the nominative. 'Новый' agrees, and 'летом' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Забора' is the genitive form showing whose colour it is. 'Цвет' is the nominative subject of 'нравится', with 'мне' as the dative experiencer.
